name: High-Rate Deep Bed Commercial Sand Filter
shortDescription: Industrial fiberglass reinforced bobbin-wound sand filter with multi-port valve for crystal clear filtration.
description: Engineered for residential villas and resort commercial pools. Continuous operating pressure up to 2.5 bar, UV-resistant tank casing, and automated lateral arm system.

name: Variable Speed Inverter Pool Pump 2.0 HP
shortDescription: Ultra-silent permanent magnet motor saving up to 80% electrical consumption with smart digital timer.
description: High hydraulic efficiency with oversized strainer basket, quick-lock transparent lid, and IP55 weatherproof motor insulation.

shortDescription: 100% leakproof resin-filled underwater swimming pool lamp with RF wireless remote synchronization.
description: Flat mounted design eliminating niche recessing requirements. 16 pre-programmed color themes, 316 stainless steel trim ring, and 50,000 hours operating lifespan.

name: Automated Robotic Pool Vacuum Cleaner
shortDescription: Smart navigation robotic cleaner for floor, waterline, and wall scrubbing with dual cartridge filters.
